name: Finder
notes: The sidebar lists Favorites, iCloud, Locations and Tags. Cmd+Shift+N makes a new folder; Cmd+Shift+G opens Go to Folder; Space previews the selected file with Quick Look; Cmd+I shows Get Info; Cmd+Delete moves to Trash. View modes (icon, list, column, gallery) are the four buttons in the toolbar or Cmd+1 to Cmd+4.

name: Safari
notes: Cmd+L focuses the address bar; Cmd+T opens a new tab; Cmd+Shift+T reopens the last closed tab; Cmd+D bookmarks the page; the Share button and Reader are at the right end of the address bar. Downloads open from the arrow button in the toolbar. Private windows are Cmd+Shift+N.

name: Google Chrome
notes: Cmd+L focuses the address bar (searches too); Cmd+T new tab; Cmd+W closes the tab; Cmd+Shift+T reopens it; Cmd+D bookmarks. The three-dot menu at the top right holds Settings, Extensions, Downloads and Print. Profile switching is the avatar left of that menu.

name: Firefox
notes: Cmd+L focuses the address bar; Cmd+T new tab; Cmd+Shift+P opens a private window; the hamburger menu at the top right holds Settings, Add-ons and Downloads. Reader view is the page icon in the address bar.

name: Mail
notes: Cmd+N starts a new message; Cmd+R replies, Cmd+Shift+R replies all, Cmd+Shift+F forwards; Cmd+Shift+D sends. The mailbox list is the left column, the message list is the middle, the message is on the right. Search is the field at the top right. Cmd+Shift+U marks unread.

name: Notes
notes: Cmd+N makes a new note in the selected folder; the folder list is the left column, the note list the middle. Cmd+Shift+N makes a new folder. Formatting (Title, Heading, checklist, table) is in the Aa button in the toolbar; Cmd+Shift+L toggles a checklist. Search is the field above the note list.

name: Calendar
notes: Cmd+N creates an event; double-clicking an empty slot in Day or Week view also creates one there. Day/Week/Month/Year are the segmented buttons in the toolbar (Cmd+1 to Cmd+4). Cmd+T jumps to today. The Calendars sidebar toggles with the Calendars button; each calendar has a checkbox.

name: Reminders
notes: Cmd+N adds a reminder to the open list; lists are in the sidebar; the plus button at the bottom of the sidebar makes a list. Clicking the i button on a reminder sets date, time, location and priority. Completed items hide unless Show Completed is on in the View menu.

name: Messages
notes: Conversations are the left column; the compose button (pencil) at the top starts a new one; type a name or number in the To field. The message field is at the bottom; Return sends; Shift+Return makes a new line. Drag a file into the message field to attach it.

name: FaceTime
notes: New FaceTime is the green button at the top of the sidebar; type a contact name, number or email, then choose Audio or Video. Create Link makes a shareable call link. Recent calls list under the button.

name: Contacts
notes: The plus button at the bottom of the card list adds a contact; Cmd+N does the same. Edit is the button at the bottom of an open card. Groups are the leftmost column (View > Show Groups if hidden).

name: System Settings
notes: Settings panes are the scrolling sidebar on the left; the search field at its top finds any setting by name. Privacy & Security holds Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone and Camera lists; each list has a toggle per app and unlocks with the user's password. Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and Network are near the top of the sidebar; Displays and Sound further down; General holds Software Update and Login Items.

name: Terminal
notes: Text is typed at the prompt and run with Return. Cmd+T opens a new tab, Cmd+N a new window. Ctrl+C cancels the running command; Ctrl+L or Cmd+K clears the screen. Never suggest typing commands the user did not ask for; describe what a command does before pointing at Return.

name: Visual Studio Code
notes: Cmd+P opens a file by name; Cmd+Shift+P opens the Command Palette; Cmd+B toggles the sidebar; Ctrl+` toggles the terminal panel. The Activity Bar on the far left switches Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run and Extensions. Cmd+, opens Settings. Cmd+S saves.

name: Cursor
notes: Same layout as VS Code: Cmd+P for files, Cmd+Shift+P for the Command Palette, Ctrl+` for the terminal. Cmd+K edits the selection with AI inline; Cmd+L opens the AI chat panel on the right; Cmd+I opens the agent composer.

name: Xcode
notes: The Navigator is the left column (Cmd+1 files, Cmd+2 source control, Cmd+5 issues). Cmd+R builds and runs; Cmd+B builds; Cmd+. stops. The scheme and destination (simulator) pickers are in the toolbar next to the Run button. The Inspector is the right column; Cmd+Option+0 toggles it. Simulators come from Xcode > Open Developer Tool > Simulator.

name: Slack
notes: Channels and DMs are the left sidebar; Cmd+K jumps to any channel or person by name. The message box is at the bottom; Return sends, Shift+Return adds a line. Threads open on the right when you click Reply. Search is the bar at the top. Huddle (call) is the headphones button in a channel header.

name: Discord
notes: Servers are the far-left column of icons; channels are the next column; the chat is in the middle; members on the right. Cmd+K jumps to a channel or person. The message box is at the bottom; Return sends. Voice channels connect on click; disconnect with the phone-hangup button above the user panel at bottom left.

name: WhatsApp
notes: Chats are the left column; the pencil/new-chat button at its top starts a chat; search is the field above the chat list. The message field is at the bottom of the open chat; Return sends. Attachments are the paperclip or plus button beside the message field.

name: Telegram
notes: Chats are the left column with search at the top. The message field is at the bottom of a chat; Return sends. The pencil/compose button starts a new message; attachments use the paperclip. Settings are behind the hamburger menu at top left.

name: Zoom
notes: Home shows New Meeting, Join, Schedule and Share Screen tiles. In a meeting the toolbar at the bottom has Mute (Cmd+Shift+A), Video (Cmd+Shift+V), Participants, Chat, Share Screen (Cmd+Shift+S) and Leave at the right end. The toolbar hides until the mouse moves.

name: Google Meet
notes: Mic and camera toggles are the bottom-centre buttons (Cmd+D mutes, Cmd+E toggles camera); Present now is the up-arrow icon; the red phone button leaves. People, Chat and Activities are the icons at the bottom right. Captions are the CC button.

name: Microsoft Teams
notes: The left rail switches Activity, Chat, Teams, Calendar and Calls. New chat is the pencil icon above the chat list. In a meeting, mute, camera, share and Leave are in the top bar. Cmd+E focuses search.

name: Spotify
notes: Search is the magnifier in the left sidebar or the top bar (Cmd+K). Playback controls sit at the bottom centre: shuffle, previous, play/pause (Space), next, repeat. Your Library is the left sidebar; hover a track for its play button and the three-dot menu for Add to playlist.

name: Music
notes: Search is the field at the top of the sidebar; Listen Now, Browse, Radio and the Library sections are sidebar entries. Space plays or pauses; the transport is at the top. Playlists are at the bottom of the sidebar; File > New > Playlist makes one.

name: Photos
notes: Library, Memories, Albums and Projects are in the sidebar. Double-click a photo to open it; Return also opens; Edit is the button at the top right of an open photo, Done saves. Cmd+I shows info; Delete moves to Recently Deleted. Import is File > Import or Cmd+Shift+I.

name: Preview
notes: The Markup toolbar toggles with the pen-in-circle button (Cmd+Shift+A) and holds text, shapes, sign and highlight tools. Thumbnails/sidebar toggles with the sidebar button (Cmd+Option+2 shows thumbnails). Tools > Adjust Size resizes images; File > Export saves as another format. Cmd+S saves.

name: Pages
notes: Format panel on the right (the paintbrush) holds font, size, alignment and paragraph styles; Document panel (the page icon) holds margins and page setup. Insert menu adds tables, charts, images. File > Export To makes a PDF or Word file. Cmd+S saves.

name: Numbers
notes: Sheets are tabs across the top; each sheet holds tables. Type = in a cell to start a formula; the Format panel on the right sets cell type and style. Insert > Chart charts the selection. File > Export To makes Excel or CSV.

name: Keynote
notes: Slides are the left navigator; the plus button at top left adds a slide. Play (the triangle at top right) presents; Escape stops. Format on the right styles the selection; Animate adds transitions and builds. File > Export To makes PDF or PowerPoint.

name: Microsoft Word
notes: The ribbon tabs (Home, Insert, Layout, References, Review) run across the top. Cmd+S saves; Cmd+B/I/U format; Cmd+Shift+S is Save As. Track Changes is on the Review tab. Styles are on the Home tab.

name: Microsoft Excel
notes: Formulas start with = in a cell; the formula bar sits under the ribbon. Sheets are tabs at the bottom; the plus adds one. Insert tab holds charts and pivot tables; Data tab holds Sort & Filter. Cmd+T on a range makes a table.

name: Microsoft PowerPoint
notes: Slides are the left thumbnail pane; Home > New Slide adds one. Slide Show tab or the Play button presents; Escape exits. Design tab holds themes; Transitions and Animations are their own tabs.

name: Microsoft Outlook
notes: New Email is the button at the top left; folders are the left column; the reading pane is on the right. Reply, Reply All and Forward are above the message. Calendar, Contacts and Tasks switch from the icons at the bottom left or the left rail. Cmd+Return sends.

name: Microsoft OneNote
notes: Notebooks, sections and pages are the left columns; Add Page is at the bottom of the page list. Click anywhere on a page to start a note container. Insert tab adds tables, files and images.

name: Notion
notes: Pages are the left sidebar; the plus next to a page adds a subpage. Type / in a page to insert any block (heading, table, database, toggle). Cmd+K or Cmd+P opens search. Database views are tabs at the top of a database; New is the blue button at its top right. Share is at the top right of a page.

name: Obsidian
notes: Cmd+N makes a new note; Cmd+O opens the quick switcher; Cmd+P opens the command palette. Files are the left sidebar; the right sidebar holds backlinks and outline. Type [[ to link a note. Settings is the gear at the bottom left.

name: Bear
notes: Tags are the left column, notes the middle, editor on the right. Cmd+N makes a note; type #tag in the note to tag it. Cmd+Shift+F searches all notes.

name: Things
notes: Inbox, Today, Upcoming, Anytime and Someday are in the sidebar with projects below. Cmd+N makes a to-do in the current list; Cmd+Shift+N makes a project. Cmd+K completes the selected to-do; the calendar icon on a to-do sets a date.

name: Todoist
notes: Add task is the plus at the top of the sidebar (Q anywhere). Type a date in the task text, like tomorrow 9am, and it is parsed. Projects are in the sidebar; Inbox, Today and Upcoming above them. Click a task to open its details on the right.

name: Linear
notes: C creates a new issue; Cmd+K opens the command menu for any action. Teams and projects are in the left sidebar; views (Active, Backlog, Triage) are tabs at the top of a team. An issue's status, priority and assignee are the properties on the right of the issue page.

name: Jira
notes: Create is the blue button in the top bar; it opens a form where Project and Issue type come first, then Summary. Boards and backlogs are in the left sidebar of a project. Dragging a card between columns changes its status. Filters is in the top navigation.

name: Confluence
notes: Create is the blue button in the top bar; it makes a page in the current space. The page tree is the left sidebar. Edit is the pencil at the top right of a page; Publish (or Update) is the blue button at the top right while editing. Type / in the editor to insert macros.

name: Asana
notes: Create is the plus button at the top left of the page. Projects are in the left sidebar; a project has List, Board, Timeline and Calendar tabs. Click a task to open its detail panel on the right; the checkmark circle completes it.

name: Trello
notes: Boards hold lists; each list has Add a card at its bottom. Drag cards between lists. Click a card to open it: description, checklists, due date and labels live in the card panel with the actions on its right. Boards menu is in the top bar.

name: Airtable
notes: Tables are tabs across the top of a base; views are the left panel. The plus row at the bottom of the grid adds a record; the plus at the end of the header row adds a field. Expand a record with the arrows icon beside the primary field.

name: Figma
notes: The toolbar is at the bottom centre (Move V, Frame F, Rectangle R, Text T, Pen P). Layers panel is on the left, Design/Prototype properties on the right. Cmd+/ opens quick actions. Present is the play button at the top right; Share is beside it. Cmd+D duplicates; Cmd+G groups.

name: Canva
notes: Design elements (Elements, Text, Uploads, Photos) are the left rail; click one to add it to the page. Pages are the bottom strip; Add page is below the current page. Share and Download are at the top right. Selecting an item shows its toolbar above the canvas.

name: Miro
notes: Tools are the left toolbar (select, text, sticky note, shapes, connector, pen). Zoom controls are at the bottom right; Space+drag pans. Share and Present are at the top right. Frames are listed in the Frames panel from the left toolbar.

name: Adobe Photoshop
notes: Tools are the left column; options for the selected tool run along the top. Layers panel is bottom right (F7 shows it). Cmd+T free-transforms; Cmd+J duplicates a layer; Cmd+Shift+S is Save As; File > Export > Export As makes PNG/JPG. Zoom is Cmd+plus/minus.

name: Adobe Illustrator
notes: Tools are the left column (Selection V, Direct Selection A, Pen P, Type T, Shapes M/L). Properties and Layers panels are on the right. Cmd+G groups; Cmd+Shift+O outlines type; File > Export > Export As exports. Artboards tool is Shift+O.

name: Adobe Premiere Pro
notes: Project panel is bottom left, timeline bottom right, program monitor top right, source monitor top left. I and O set in/out points; comma and period insert/overwrite; Cmd+K cuts at the playhead. File > Export > Media (Cmd+M) opens export.

name: DaVinci Resolve
notes: The page tabs (Media, Cut, Edit, Fusion, Color, Fairlight, Deliver) are the icons along the bottom. On the Edit page the media pool is top left, the timeline bottom, the viewer top right. Cmd+B splits a clip at the playhead (blade); Deliver page renders with Add to Render Queue then Render All.

name: Final Cut Pro
notes: The browser is top left, the viewer top right, the timeline at the bottom. Cmd+B blades at the playhead; E appends to the timeline; W inserts. Inspector is Cmd+4. Share/export is the share button at the top right or File > Share.

name: Logic Pro
notes: Tracks are the main area; the plus above the track headers adds a track. R records; Space plays; Return goes to the start. The Library is the left panel (Y), the Inspector next to it (I), the Mixer at the bottom (X). Loops are in the right panel (O).

name: GarageBand
notes: The plus button above the track headers adds a track and asks which kind. The red button records; Space plays. The Loop browser is the loop icon at the top right; the Smart Controls and Editor toggle with the buttons at the top left.

name: Ableton Live
notes: Tab switches Session and Arrangement views. The browser is the left column with Instruments, Audio Effects and Samples. Cmd+T adds an audio track, Cmd+Shift+T a MIDI track. Space plays; the record button in the top transport arms recording.

name: FL Studio
notes: The Channel Rack (F6) holds instruments and step sequencing; the Piano Roll (F7) edits notes; the Playlist (F5) arranges patterns; the Mixer (F9) mixes. The Browser is the left column. Space plays; the Pattern/Song switch is in the transport at the top.

name: Blender
notes: The 3D viewport is centre; the Outliner is top right and Properties below it. Tab toggles Edit mode; G moves, R rotates, S scales; Shift+A adds an object. Workspace tabs (Layout, Modeling, Sculpting, Shading) run across the top. F12 renders.

name: Docker Desktop
notes: Containers, Images, Volumes and Builds are the left sidebar. Each container row has play/stop and a trash action at its right. Settings is the gear at the top right; the whale menu-bar icon also quits or restarts Docker.

name: Postman
notes: Collections are the left sidebar; the plus tab at the top opens a new request. The method dropdown is left of the URL field; Send is the blue button to its right. Params, Headers and Body are tabs under the URL; the response appears below.

name: TablePlus
notes: Connections are the launcher window; tables are the left sidebar once connected. Cmd+E opens a SQL editor; Cmd+Return runs the query. Edited cells are pending until Cmd+S commits them.

name: GitHub Desktop
notes: Current repository and branch are the two dropdowns at the top left; Fetch/Push/Pull is the button to their right. Changes are the left column; the summary field and Commit button sit at its bottom. History is the tab beside Changes.

name: GitHub
notes: A repository's tabs (Code, Issues, Pull requests, Actions, Settings) run across the top. The green Code button gives clone URLs. New issue and New pull request are green buttons on their tabs. Press . on a repo to open the web editor. The file tree is the left column in a file view.

name: Gmail
notes: Compose is the button at the top left (C also works). Labels and Inbox are the left column; the search bar is at the top. In an open email, Reply and Forward are at its bottom; Cmd+Return sends a draft. Archive is the box icon in the toolbar above the message; E archives.

name: Google Calendar
notes: Create is the plus button at the top left (C also works); clicking an empty slot creates an event there. Day/Week/Month is the dropdown at the top right; T goes to today. Calendars are checkboxes in the left column. Save is the blue button in the event editor.

name: Google Docs
notes: Saves automatically. The toolbar under the menu holds styles, font, size and alignment; Insert menu adds images, tables and links. Share is the blue button at the top right. Cmd+Option+1/2/3 apply headings; Cmd+Shift+C shows word count. Comments are Cmd+Option+M.

name: Google Sheets
notes: Type = in a cell to start a formula. Sheets are tabs at the bottom; the plus adds one. Data > Create a filter filters the range; Insert > Chart charts the selection. Share is the blue button at the top right. Saves automatically.

name: Google Slides
notes: Slides are the left filmstrip; the plus at the top left adds a slide. Present is the button at the top right; Escape exits. Insert adds text boxes, images and shapes. Theme and Layout are in the toolbar.

name: Google Drive
notes: New is the button at the top left (folder, upload, or a new Docs/Sheets/Slides file). My Drive, Shared with me and Recent are the left column. Right-click a file for Share, Move, Rename and Download. Search is the bar at the top.

name: YouTube
notes: Search is the bar at the top. In a video, K or Space pauses, J/L skip 10 s, F is fullscreen, M mutes; Subscribe and Like are under the player; Save adds to a playlist. Your channel and Studio are behind the avatar at the top right.

name: LinkedIn
notes: Home, My Network, Jobs, Messaging and Notifications are the top navigation. Start a post is the box at the top of the feed. Connect and Message are the buttons under a person's name on their profile; More holds Follow and Share profile. Search is the bar at the top left.

name: X
notes: Post is the blue button in the left sidebar (N also opens the composer). The Home feed has For you and Following tabs. Reply, repost, like and share are under each post. Search is the field at the top of the right column.

name: Reddit
notes: Create post is the plus button in the top bar; choose the community first. Subreddits are in the left sidebar. Upvote/downvote arrows are on the left of each post; Comment opens the thread. Search is the bar at the top.

name: Amazon
notes: Search is the bar at the top. Add to Cart and Buy Now are in the buy box on the right of a product page. The cart is the icon at the top right; Proceed to checkout is on the cart page. Do not place an order without the user's explicit confirmation.

name: Stripe Dashboard
notes: Payments, Balances, Customers and Products are the left sidebar; the Test mode toggle is at the top right. Search (Cmd+K) finds a customer or payment by id or email. Developers holds API keys and webhooks. Never reveal or paste secret keys.

name: Supabase Dashboard
notes: The left rail switches Table Editor, SQL Editor, Authentication, Storage, Edge Functions, Logs and Project Settings. In the SQL Editor, Cmd+Return runs the query. Table Editor has Insert row and a filter bar. Project Settings > API holds the URL and keys; do not read keys aloud.

name: Vercel
notes: Projects are the dashboard grid; a project has Overview, Deployments, Analytics, Logs and Settings tabs. Add New at the top right creates a project or domain. Each deployment row opens its build logs; Promote to Production and Redeploy are in its three-dot menu.

name: AWS Console
notes: Search services by name in the top bar. The region dropdown is at the top right; the wrong region hides resources. Each service has its own left sidebar. Billing is behind the account name at the top right. Confirm before any Create, Delete or Terminate.

name: HubSpot
notes: Contacts, Companies, Deals and Tickets are under CRM in the left sidebar; Create is the orange button at the top right of each list. Deals have a Board and Table view. A record page has the timeline in the middle and properties on the left.

name: Salesforce
notes: Objects (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities) are tabs across the top of the app; New is the button at the top right of a list view. Record pages have Details and Related tabs. The App Launcher is the grid icon at the top left. Global search is the bar at the top.

name: Shopify
notes: Orders, Products, Customers and Analytics are the left sidebar; Add product is at the top right of Products. Online Store > Themes customizes the storefront. Settings is at the bottom of the sidebar; Payments and Shipping live there.

name: ChatGPT
notes: The message box is at the bottom; Return sends, Shift+Return adds a line; the paperclip or plus attaches files. New chat is the pencil icon at the top of the left sidebar; past chats are listed below it. The model picker is at the top of the conversation.

name: Claude
notes: The message box is at the bottom; Return sends, Shift+Return adds a line; the plus attaches files. New chat is at the top of the left sidebar; Projects and recent chats are below. The model selector is under the message box. Artifacts open in a right-hand panel.

name: Raycast
notes: Opens with its global hotkey (Option+Space by default); type to search apps, files, commands and extensions; Return runs the selected row; Cmd+K shows actions for it. Settings are Cmd+, while Raycast is open.

name: 1Password
notes: Credential surface: do not read fields aloud or point at password values. The vault list is the left column; search is at the top; the plus button creates an item. Guide only at the level of which button to press, never the contents.

name: App Store
notes: Search is the field at the top of the sidebar. Get or the price button installs; Update is on the Updates page in the sidebar; the account is the name at the bottom of the sidebar. Installing may ask for the Apple ID password, which the user types themselves.

name: Activity Monitor
notes: CPU, Memory, Energy, Disk and Network are the tabs at the top. Click a column header to sort; the search field at the top right filters by name. The X (stop) button in the toolbar quits the selected process after a confirmation.

name: Maps
notes: Search is the field at the top of the sidebar. Directions is the arrow button next to it; choose drive, walk, transit or cycle at the top of the directions panel. Zoom with the plus/minus at the bottom right or pinch. Look Around is the binoculars icon.

name: Freeform
notes: The toolbar at the top adds sticky notes, shapes, text, and media; drawing tools are the pen icon. Boards are in the sidebar; the new-board button is at the top. Pinch or Cmd+plus/minus zooms.

name: Shortcuts
notes: The plus at the top right makes a new shortcut; actions are searched in the right panel and dragged into the editor. Run is the play button at the top right. Gallery in the sidebar has ready-made shortcuts.

name: Books
notes: Library sections are in the sidebar; double-click a book to open it. In a book, the table of contents is the list icon at the top left, appearance (font, theme) is the Aa button, and bookmarks are the ribbon.

name: Podcasts
notes: Search is the field at the top of the sidebar; Follow on a show page subscribes. Up Next and Downloaded are in the sidebar. Playback controls are at the top; the queue is the list icon at the top right.

name: TV
notes: Watch Now, Apple TV+, Store and Library are sidebar entries; search is at the top of the sidebar. Purchases and rentals ask for confirmation and the Apple ID password, which the user enters themselves.

name: Loom
notes: New recording is the Record a video button; choose Screen and camera, Screen only or Camera only, then Start recording. The recording control bar sits at the bottom left; the red button stops. Videos land in the Library with a Share button at the top right.

name: Superhuman
notes: Cmd+K runs any command by name. C composes; R replies; E marks done (archive); H sets a reminder. The inbox has Important and Other splits at the top. Cmd+Return sends.

name: Screenshot
notes: The floating toolbar offers capture entire screen, window, or selection, and record entire screen or selection. Options sets the save location and timer. Capture or Record is the button at the right end; Escape cancels.
